page_title: Rose Farm Lodge: a quiet countryside stay
hero_title: A quiet countryside lodge, just for you
hero_text: A converted stone barn on our family smallholding. It sleeps 4, dogs are welcome, and the kettle's on when you arrive.

highlights.title: Book direct with us
highlights.text: Booking with us directly means no booking fees. You'll deal with us, the owners, from the first message to the day you leave.

highlights.title: Peace and quiet
highlights.text: Wake up to birdsong and views across the farm. There's no through traffic, just the odd tractor.

highlights.title: Plenty nearby
highlights.text: Footpaths start from the gate. The village pub is a 10-minute walk, and the market town is 15 minutes by car.

reviews.quote: Spotless, cosy and so peaceful. The welcome hamper was a lovely touch.
